## About
B & M Exhaust Center is an exhaust shop on Garden Grove Blvd in Garden Grove. We work on OE original equipment and performance upgrades alike, on any make or model.
We're part of TEC Performance Exhaust Center, Inc, along with our sister shop, Tony's Exhaust and Converter Center in Whittier. Both shops are set up to handle exhaust problems and upgrades.
Neighbors who leave reviews tend to mention Octavio, the shop owner, and Ernie by name. They also mention honest work and being shown exactly what was done to their car.

## Services
- Exhaust repair and modification: Repairs and changes to your exhaust system.
- Exhaust installation and fabrication: New exhaust installs and custom fabrication work.
- Catalytic converters: OE and OE replacement catalytic converters.
- Mufflers: OE replacement mufflers for your car.
- Intake upgrades and modifications: Upgrades and modifications to your air intake.
- Stripped or damaged stud removal: Removal of stripped or damaged studs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Yes. We handle exhaust issues on any make or model car.

Q: My catalytic converter was stolen. Can you help?
A: Yes. One reviewer whose converter was stolen said Octavio showed them the root cause and gave them a flat rate on the fix.

Q: Can I come in on a Sunday?
A: The Garden Grove shop is closed on Sunday. Please call our sister shop, Tony's Exhaust and Converter Center in Whittier, about an appointment.
